params.notes: Opaque, the bottom of the whole scene. colour = base + halo * h(r); r = distance to the nearer big dial centre in R units; h = 1 for r <= r0, exp(-(r - r0) / w) beyond. Values are sRGB 0-255 (dithered). No vertical gradient and no vignette are measurable on the drawn background; the halo is seen in 02 only (weak), 04 is flat.
params.alternatives: procedural: 2 colours + 2 numbers in WBBACK (0 bytes, 0 extra layers); @0.25x file 480x180 = 691200 bytes

open_questions: The fitted background is almost black (base rgb ~0,0.5,1.5 + a 1,1,2 halo). 2.64 MiB (w*h*8) for it is poor value: recommend folding the 4 numbers into the existing WBBACK effect (0 bytes, no new layer) or, if it must be an image, the @0.25x variant (0.66 MiB). P9 decides.
